name: radio
title: Radio group
description: A real fieldset of native radios: arrow keys, one choice per name, required and submitting all stay the browser's, with or without JavaScript. Quiet is hairline circles drawn by CSS; warm draws pencil circles and circles the choice in ink, a leaning oval that runs past its start; playful turns the choice into a four-petalled kolam flower. Forced colours bring back the system radios.
